scope: future DSA O-track HK daily-data quality recovery only

routing_rules.when: original provider passes 21-bar latest-session and OHLCV integrity gates
original provider fails OHLC geometry and Tencent unadjusted bar is valid on the exact failing session and Tencent qfq has >=21 ordered valid bars through target session
adjusted Yahoo vs Tencent series disagree but Yahoo raw vs Tencent raw agree within the frozen raw-price diagnostic boundary and Tencent qfq has a valid 21-bar target-complete series
routing_rules.reason: adjustment or rounding disagreement rather than raw-market disagreement

routing_rules.when: Yahoo is missing target-complete 21-bar history but Tencent qfq supplies >=21 valid ordered bars through target session with actual target-session data
Yahoo raw vs Tencent raw remain materially conflicting under the frozen diagnostic boundary
routing_rules.reason: do not choose a favorable provider without third-source arbitration

routing_rules.when: Tencent history itself is stale before target or evidence indicates suspension/no-trade
routing_rules.reason: do not synthesize missing market sessions

raw_agreement_boundary.tight: per OHLC field abs_diff <= max(HKD 0.01, 0.1% of price) over 21 overlapping sessions
raw_agreement_boundary.loose: per OHLC field abs_diff <= max(HKD 0.02, 0.2% of price) over 21 overlapping sessions
raw_agreement_boundary.policy: tight and loose categories are recoverable only because raw prices agree and Tencent qfq independently passes integrity; raw conflict remains isolated
